subject: numeracy
nipun_lo: Grade 3 goal: reads and writes numbers up to 9999 and solves simple multiplication problems; this episode covers hundreds, tens and ones up to 999
chapter: NCERT Class 3 Mathematics: numbers up to 999 (hundreds, tens and ones)
notes: Ten ones make a ten; ten tens make a hundred. Show it with sticks: bundles of 10, and a big bundle of 10 tens for 100. A three-digit number is hundreds, tens and ones: 346 is 3 hundreds, 4 tens and 6 ones. Read and say numbers from their parts and the reverse, including numbers with a zero inside, such as 405 (4 hundreds, no tens, 5 ones). Compare two three-digit numbers by looking at the hundreds first, then the tens, then the ones. Every number stays at 999 or below.
